scope.scenario: 96 synthetic pilots, 96 physical cores on the Space server, 48 pair flight areas, real WebSocket relay, 500 steps per run. Production engine and aircraft, compatibility solver used for both solid propeller and aircraft root; 128 rpm.
scope.cutoff: All measured steps longer than 150 ms. Elapsed time through the slowest pilot is recorded. Timing method buckets are inclusive and may overlap.
scope.wallAndCpu: process.threadCpuUsage recorded in each worker. Node GC events of at least 1 ms were correlated against the worker time window. The host CPU scheduling cap was verified separately. Diagnostic instrumentation is enabled only in the test copies.
scope.candidateBoxPairVisits: Sum of swept-AABB box pair batches seen by the entity solver of the slowest worker. Counts include repeat passes over the same pair, substeps and solver iterations.
scope.exactOrientedTests: Candidate entries with current AABB overlap, submitted to exact oriented box contact geometry.
scope.deepBreakdown: Timings for batch candidate query, OBB input preparation and SAT, plus the JS candidate visit loop. Sweep timing extrapolates a sample of one out of 127 calls, and is a subset of visitPairsMs.
